infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Rally shows you on your chapter's live map and confirms you're at an event when you check in. Only members of your organization can see you, and only while sharing is on.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo to use as your profile picture or to send in a chat.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo for your profile picture or to send in a chat.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Rally shows your Apple and Google calendar events next to your chapter's, and lets you add chapter events to your calendar. Your events stay on this phone.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Rally shows your Apple and Google calendar events next to your chapter's, and lets you add chapter events to your calendar. Your events stay on this phone.
